resolved_source_issues.issue: The inherited draft repeatedly narrated what the lecture and production process were doing instead of presenting prepared physics notes.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The instructional body now speaks directly through definitions, derivations, examples, and classroom exchanges; provenance remains confined to the title page and audit files.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The shared-state slogan obscured the actual definition of entanglement.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: Entanglement is defined by failure of bipartite pure-state factorization, with local basis independence stated explicitly.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The inherited visual set covered only four unevenly selected moments and included a speculative redraw.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: Ten full-resolution source frames now span the lecture from wave functions through Bell's separated-computer argument; the unsupported redraw was removed.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The reduced-density index convention was inconsistent between its definition and matrix action.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The chapter uses rho_A indexed by row a and column a-prime, writes local expectations as a trace, and verifies the product-state projector action.

resolved_source_issues.issue: A loose spoken statement could imply that every reduced-density eigenvalue must be nonzero in an entangled state.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The criterion is corrected to more than one nonzero Schmidt eigenvalue, with zero eigenvalues allowed outside the occupied support.

resolved_source_issues.issue: Local mixedness could be mistaken for an unconditional proof of entanglement.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The text states that local mixedness certifies bipartite entanglement only when the global state is known to be pure.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The singlet could be described as the ground state without specifying the interaction sign.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: Singlet relaxation is tied explicitly to antiferromagnetic coupling J greater than zero; the opposite sign reverses the ordering.

resolved_source_issues.issue: Measurement of sigma dot tau could be conflated with simultaneous local measurements of incompatible components.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The chapter separates one-product comparison, three-subensemble reconstruction, and a genuinely joint singlet-triplet apparatus.

resolved_source_issues.issue: Collapse, weak measurement, and inefficient readout were compressed into one apparatus narrative.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: Outcome conditioning, unitary system-apparatus entanglement, weak coupling, and downstream record loss are treated separately.

resolved_source_issues.issue: Bell nonlocality could be mistaken for a controllable faster-than-light signal.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: A reduced-state no-signaling derivation precedes the local hidden-variable simulation argument, including shared randomness, measurement settings, and global classical simulation.
